mainEntity.name: What is an exterior stucco coating and how does it differ from traditional stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: An exterior stucco coating is a durable, flexible finish applied over existing stucco. Unlike traditional stucco, which is a cement-based material, coatings are typically acrylic or elastomeric. These coatings form a protective barrier that resists cracking, fading, and water penetration more effectively than standard paint or unsealed stucco. They are designed to extend the lifespan of your stucco by protecting it from environmental elements and reducing maintenance needs, often lasting significantly longer than conventional paint applications.
acceptedAnswer.description: An exterior stucco coating is a flexible, durable finish applied over existing stucco, offering enhanced protection against cracking, fading, and water compared to traditional stucco or paint.
